question: By what nature does the yogin operate in this realization?
premises: The yogin operates by an unsurpassed nature.
That nature functions through the activity of speech.
It is united with the dissolution and flourishing of the supreme I in reflective consciousness.
inference: Therefore the yogin acts from the unsurpassed nature that expresses itself through speech and the play of supreme I-consciousness.
plain_english: By the unsurpassed nature that operates through the activity of speech, united with the dissolution and flourishing of the supreme I in the reflective awareness of consciousness.
